question: Find the value of x satisfying: 3(3x² − 6) − 3(3x² + 5x − 7) = 19
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Factor out the common multiplier **3**: 3[(3x² − 6) − (3x² + 5x − 7)] = 19

Subtract the expressions inside the bracket: 3[3x² − 6 − 3x² − 5x + 7] = 19

Eliminate the quadratic terms: 3[−5x + 1] = 19

Simplify and solve: −15x + 3 = 19 ⇒ −15x = 16

**∴ The correct answer is −16/15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 3(3x² − 6) − 3(3x² + 5x − 7) = 19

Apply the **distributive property** to expand the brackets:

⇒ (9x² − 18) − (9x² + 15x − 21) = 19

Remove the parentheses and change the signs for the second term:

⇒ 9x² − 18 − 9x² − 15x + 21 = 19

Combine **like terms**:

⇒ (9x² − 9x²) − 15x + (−18 + 21) = 19

⇒ −15x + 3 = 19

Isolate the **variable x** by moving the constant to the right side:

⇒ −15x = 19 − 3

⇒ −15x = 16

⇒ x = −16/15

**∴ The correct answer is −16/15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Distributive Property

Multiplying a sum by a number is the same as multiplying each addend by the number and then adding the products: a(b + c) = ab + ac.

Linear Equations in One Variable

Equations where the highest power of the variable is 1. Standard form is ax + b = 0.

Combining Like Terms

Terms with the same variable and same exponent can be simplified by adding or subtracting their coefficients.</p
